","^Теллер теперь водит водовозку. Нашивки у меня в ящике. Два складских грузовика с такими же дешевыми тормозными тягами сняты с рейсов, пока их не осмотрит Лена. Командование не ответило. Это я тоже записываю.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Рапорт о налете и тормозная тяга записаны на одной странице, а командование читает только верх. Два складских грузовика с такими же дешевыми тормозными тягами сняты с рейсов, пока их не осмотрит Лена. Дальше моих записей дело не идет.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^Капрал Теллер вернулся с мойки с мокрыми руками и с легким кошелем. Чего я не вижу, того не записываю. А я ничего не видел.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","^Солдаты покупают воду в Чаше, а Чаша болтает над кружками. Теперь мои люди едут обратно и спрашивают, выдержат ли их тормоза. Чаша узнала от тебя раньше, чем мой журнал. Этот порядок я запомню.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-12":["
","^Кусок армейской стали с фургона «Седьмой» продали на <term=salvage_yard>Свалке</term>. Продажу я записал. Твое имя стоит в строке, рядом с ценой.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-13":["
","^Старый сад, склад Старой армии. Станки принадлежат Гильдии, командование их арендует. Кто платит аренду, это выше моего чина.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_workshop","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-14":["
","^Нет пушки, нет пропуска. Вместе с пропуском мастерская выдает каждому водителю стальное крепление, так что никто не скажет мне, что ему некуда было ставить пушку. Что станет с креплением потом, это дело водителя и <term=pierce>«Пирса»</term>. «Пирс» пишет свою бумагу. Я не спрашиваю.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_gate_law","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_paper","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-15":["
","^Тэмсин Роу, из Гильдии. Гильдия возит почту между городами. Своей пушки у нее нет. Винтовку носит курьер, который ездит с ней. Вдвоем они через мои ворота проходят, но мне не нравится, чему это учит других водителей. Храбрость это или глупость, я ещё не решил.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_courier","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-16":["
","^Это страховка. Она платит водителю, если по его грузовику стреляли. «Пирс» страхует любой грузовик с пушкой. Без пушки не страхует. Поэтому у ворот и выдают крепления.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_paper","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-17":["

","^I keep the Army's trucks running. Anybody else's too, if they bring them to my bench. Engines, plate, mounts, whatever breaks. I can tell what's wrong with a truck by the sound of it pulling in.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Every part does one job and fails at another. Heavy plate stops rounds, but it eats your speed. A big gun eats your deck on top of that. So buy what the road needs, not what shines on the shelf. And before you look at your guns, look at your brake rods.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_swivel","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^The Salvage Yard, a way south of here. The crews strip whatever gets towed in, so parts go for next to nothing. You'll have to put up with the smell of burnt oil. For real plate you want the Fallen Sun, the big hull in the crater. I say that through my teeth.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_sun","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Green Pit, out past the road. It's a pump outpost round an old cistern, and they pull the water up from deep rock and sell it by the can. It's clean, and it isn't cheap. Bring M's.","
","ev","str","^greenPit","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Because command bought cheap ones for the depot trucks, and I fit them by order. I've seen what one does on a hard bend. It snaps, the pedal goes to the floor, and the truck goes where the road doesn't. Otto Brann, who made the first swivel, forges his rods twice as thick. He was right, and I told command so. Nobody asks a mechanic.","
","ev","str","^talkBrakeRod","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_rods","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_brann","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^The ones with his mark, yes. He signs every weld. A weld you can read is a weld you can trust. I've even seen <term=kiln>Kiln</term> riders running captured ones on their own trucks. Good steel doesn't care who owns it.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_brann","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^They're raiders from the camp in the south, and I'd sooner not fix a truck they've stripped. But the old woman who keeps their furnace, Dagny Brask, melts captured guns into tools. I own a few. They're decent. Don't tell command I said so.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Best metal I ever put a torch to, and the worst place to fetch it. The brass call that hull a warship. I'd like them to show me one gun mount on it. I never found one. All I ever cut there was cargo hold. And the glare off the glass around it will blind you by noon.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_sun","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Lenses cut from the fused glass, dark as smoke. I wear an old pair on bad days. I don't know who sells them now.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["

",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Чем ты тут занимаешься?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Что посоветуешь для моего грузовика?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Где взять дешевые запчасти?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Где взять чистую воду?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Почему тормозные тяги?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_swivel"},{"VAR?":"asked_rods"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ты доверяешь креплениям Бранна?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_brann"},{"VAR?":"asked_brann"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что скажешь про рейдеров Обжига?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_kiln"},{"VAR?":"asked_kiln"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что знаешь про Павшее солнце?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_sun"},"str","^fallen-sun","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"||",{"VAR?":"asked_sun"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Есть что-нибудь от бликов?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_glare"},{"VAR?":"asked_glare"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^У меня кое-что из фургона «Седьмой».","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Пока.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Держу на ходу армейские грузовики. Чужие тоже, если привезут на мой верстак. Моторы, листы, крепления, что сломалось, то и чиню. Что с грузовиком, слышу по звуку, ещё пока он заезжает.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Каждая деталь что-то умеет, а чего-то не умеет. Тяжелый лист держит пули, но жрет скорость. Большая пушка вдобавок жрет место на платформе. Так что бери то, что нужно дороге, а не то, что блестит на полке. А прежде чем смотреть пушки, проверь тормозные тяги.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_swivel","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^На Свалке, далеко на юг отсюда. Бригады разбирают всё, что туда притащат, так что детали уходят почти даром. Вонь горелого масла придется потерпеть. За настоящим листом езжай к Павшему солнцу, там большой корпус в кратере. Говорю это сквозь зубы.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_sun","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Зеленая яма, за дорогой. Насосный пост вокруг старой цистерны: воду качают из глубокой скалы и продают канистрами. Вода чистая, но не дешевая. М захвати.","
","ev","str","^greenPit","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Потому что командование купило для грузовиков депо дешевые тормозные тяги, а я их ставлю по приказу. Я видела, что бывает с такой тягой на крутом повороте. Она лопается, педаль проваливается в пол, и грузовик летит с дороги. Отто Бранн, который сделал первую турель, кует тормозные тяги вдвое толще. Он был прав, я так и сказала командованию. Механика никто не спрашивает.","
","ev","str","^talkBrakeRod","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_rods","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_brann","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^С его клеймом — да. Он подписывает каждый шов. Шов, который можно прочесть, — шов, которому можно верить. Я даже видела, как рейдеры <term=kiln>Обжига</term> ездят с трофейными креплениями на своих грузовиках. Хорошей стали всё равно, чья она.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_brann","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Рейдеры из лагеря на юге, и грузовик, который они ободрали, я бы чинить не стала. Но старуха, что держит их печь, Дагни Браск, переплавляет трофейные пушки на инструмент. Парочка у меня есть. Годные. Командованию не говори.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Лучший металл, какого касалась моя горелка, и худшее место, где его брать. Штабные зовут этот корпус боевым кораблем. Пусть покажут мне на нем хоть одно крепление под пушку. Я не нашла. Резала я там одни грузовые трюмы. А блики от стекла вокруг к полудню тебя ослепят.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_sun","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Линзы из оплавленного стекла, темные, как дым. В плохие дни я ношу старую пару. Кто их продает теперь, не знаю.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","ev","str","^wagon_bench","/str",{"x()":"begin","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","end",null],"c-10":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_swivel"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_rods"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_brann"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_brann"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_sun"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_sun"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_glare"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_glare"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Hadiza. I keep the pump and the canteen at Green Pit. Hang your rifle on the hook. Your first plate and your first cup are free. After that you pay, like everyone.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What does Green Pit sell?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why the hooks?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_hooks"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you want from me?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_want"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Water, and not much of it. The pump draws a barrel at a time from deep rock, and in a dry year it draws mud by noon.","
","^What the rock doesn't give, I buy. Salt for the pot, cloth for the tables, rations when the pot runs thin, and drums for the trucks that fill here.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_hooks","re":true},"^Because everybody drinks here. Riders from <term=kiln>Kiln</term> and soldiers from <term=nose>Nose</term> sit at the same table, and a gun on a hook can't start anything between them.","
","^The <term=farmers>Farmers</term> won't come in while the riders do. They chase riders off Bowl's roads all week, so they won't share a bench with them. If they want my water, they can drink it in their trucks.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_want","re":true},"^Bring your fights to the road, not to my door. And if you're carrying salt or cloth, sell it here before you drive on. My pot needs it more than Bowl does.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Fill your cans before you go. The next water is a long way off.","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_hooks"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_want"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Хадиза. Я держу насос и столовую в Зеленой яме. Вешай винтовку на крюк. Первая тарелка и первая кружка — даром. Дальше платишь, как и все.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Что продается в Зеленой яме?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Зачем эти крючья?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_hooks"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Чего ты хочешь от меня?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_want"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Пока.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Воду, да и той немного. Насос тянет из толщи скалы по бочке за раз, а в сухой год к полудню уже качает грязь.","
","^Чего скала не дает, я покупаю. Соль для котла, ткань на столы, пайки, когда котел пустеет, и бочки для грузовиков, которые заправляются здесь.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_hooks","re":true},"^Потому что здесь пьют все. Рейдеры из <term=kiln>Обжига</term> и солдаты с <term=nose>Носа</term> сидят за одним столом, а оружие на крюке стрельбы между ними не начнет.","
","^<term=farmers>Патруль Чаши</term> не заходит, пока здесь рейдеры. Они всю неделю гоняют рейдеров с дорог Чаши, так что на одну лавку с ними не сядут. Хотят моей воды — пусть пьют в грузовиках.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_want","re":true},"^Оставь свои драки на дороге, не тащи их к моей двери. А если везешь соль или ткань, продай здесь, прежде чем ехать дальше. Моему котлу это нужнее, чем Чаше.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Наполни канистры перед дорогой. До следующей воды далеко.","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_hooks"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_want"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","ev",{"VAR?":"pipe_fate"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^delivered","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^I heard what Mirela read out. Her trough, my hoses and your dial, and yours was the number they couldn't argue with. The steward's own crew put a meter back on the tanker's hose, and I write it down now. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":"start.14"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^filed","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Mirela read my numbers out, and the household asked where the driver was who read the dial. Nobody could say. The tanker still comes, and I still can't write it down. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":"start.14"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^sold","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^I sent the steward's oil back. Whatever he paid you to forget my dial, keep it away from my pump. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":"start.14"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^read","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^I heard my numbers were read out in the Bowl market. Then I came home and shut the shed. Please go. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":"start.14"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^seized","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The patrol came and asked me about a copy. I said I never made one, and I named nobody. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":"start.14"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^metered","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^My old meter sat on the household's tank for one night. They took it off, but its number is still chalked on the board in the Bowl market. I won't ask who fitted it. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":"start.14"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^searched","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Agnes's cot lies on its side by the door, and the pillow is cut open. The drum by the gate is empty. Agnes writes down a number and doesn't look up.","
",{"->":"start.shunned"},{"->":"start.14"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"trusted"},{"VAR?":"knows_copy"},"&&","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Agnes looks up from her dials, then at the drum by the gate.","
","^Changed your mind about the copy? ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],"nop","
","^<term=dustwell>Dustwell</term> is a small square of rust corrugated walls round a pumpjack that nods over the well. It smells of hot iron and wet stone. Pipes run from the well to the tall tanks, and water trucks wait in a line at the tanks.","
","^Every hose at the tanks has a meter box on it, except one. A big grey tanker with a lantern painted on its door is filling from that one. It sits low on its springs already.","
","^A woman in a canvas apron stands at a row of dials and copies each number into a book.","
","^A man in a grey coat sits on a drum by the gate with a mug of tea. He watches the woman, not you.","
","ev","str","^perception","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ His tea has gone cold, and he hasn't drunk any. He is listening to her. ",{"->":".^.^.^.27"},null]}],"nop","
","^Water's in the tank by the lean-to drums. Read me the big dial while you fill. Every driver does, and I write the number down with your name. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":"start.14"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Read her the big dial.","/str",{"VAR?":"knows_book"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask whether the water could be leaking.","/str",{"VAR?":"knows_book"},{"VAR?":"asked_leak"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask why the tanker's meter came off.","/str",{"VAR?":"knows_book"},{"VAR?":"knows_pipe"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask what Dustwell sends out.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Ask the man on the drum what he's waiting for.","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_man"},"!",{"VAR?":"trusted"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Tell her the man on the drum is listening.","/str",{"VAR?":"trusted"},"!",{"VAR?":"watchman"},"str","^told","/str","!=","&&","str","^perception","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=",{"VAR?":"watchman"},"str","^silent","/str","==","||","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask why she picked you.","/str",{"VAR?":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==",{"VAR?":"knows_copy"},"&&",{"VAR?":"knows_why"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask what the job pays.","/str",{"VAR?":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==",{"VAR?":"knows_copy"},"&&",{"VAR?":"knows_pay"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Say you'll carry the copy.","/str",{"VAR?":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==",{"VAR?":"knows_copy"},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Fill your tank and go.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"knows_book","re":true},"^The big dial counts every barrel the pump brings up. Once a week Agnes writes its number down and sets it back to nothing, so the number is the week's whole total.","
","^You read her this week's number. She writes it in the book and your name beside it, then holds the book up so you can see the page. You've never had your name in a pump book before.","
","^Barrels a week; Pumped up, by the big dial; Bowl's trucks, by the hose meters; Passing trucks, by the hose meters; Household tanker, by its meter ","#","^head","/#","
","^Last spring; 410; 380; 10; 20 ","#","^row","/#","
","^Midsummer; 380; 340; 10; 30 ","#","^row","/#","
","^Autumn; 350; 290; 10; meter taken off ","#","^row","/#","
","^This week; 300; 220; 10; meter taken off ","#","^row","/#","
","^Every hose has a meter, and every truck that fills goes in by name. Your tank is in the passing column, under your name. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","^The pump brings up less every season, and Bowl's trucks get less too. Until autumn the tanker's hose had a meter, and the columns added up to the barrel. Since the meter came off, the gap grows every week. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_leak","re":true},"^A leak that big would make the ground muddy. I check the tanks every day, and the ground is dry. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","^Nothing leaves here except through a hose. One hose has no meter. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^pipeBook","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"knows_pipe","re":true},"^The <term=senate>Senate</term> ordered it. That tanker belongs to the Archon's household. The Archon carries out what the Senate decides, and his household lives on the top terrace of <term=bowl>Bowl</term>. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","^Now the tanker loads and goes, and I'm not allowed to write it down. Whatever the gap is, that's what it takes. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"trusted"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
",{"->":"start.copy"},{"->":".^.^.^.27"},null]}],"nop","
","^The man in the grey coat puts down his mug and walks over. The same lantern is stitched on his collar as painted on the tanker's door.","
",{"->":"start.watched"},null],"c-3":["
","^Water, from deep rock. The pumpjack brings it up, and the trucks carry it down to <term=bowl>Bowl</term>'s canals and to the <term=granary>Granary</term>. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","^The pumpjack wears out tools. <term=nose>Nose</term> makes them, and somebody has to bring them up the road. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","ev",{"x()":"works_down"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["

facts.name: book_read
facts.text: Agnes's copy: the pump brings up less every season, and the household's tanker takes more. Her guess, if that goes on: Bowl's trucks get almost nothing by next autumn.

facts.name: margin_read
facts.text: Agnes's copy, last page: for Mirela, to compare with hers.

facts.name: offer_heard
facts.text: Steward Aurel Brede offered M's to lose the copy and forget the dial.

facts.name: reserve_known
facts.text: Steward: half of the tanker's water fills a tank under the top terrace. It is the Senate's reserve for a dry year, and only the Archon may open it.

facts.name: valve_read
facts.text: Top terrace: the household's tanker unloads into a stone tank. Its inlet has an empty flange where a meter used to sit.

facts.name: canal_matches
facts.text: Every barrel Agnes loaded onto Bowl's trucks reached Mirela's trough. The dial is the other half, and you read it.

facts.name: book_read
facts.text: Копия Агнес: насос с каждым сезоном дает меньше, а цистерна двора берет больше. Её прикидка: если так пойдет, к будущей осени грузовикам Чаши почти ничего не достанется.

facts.name: margin_read
facts.text: Копия Агнес, последняя страница: для Мирелы, сверить со своей книгой.

facts.name: offer_heard
facts.text: Управляющий Аурел Бреде предложил М, чтобы копия пропала, а цифра со счетчика забылась.

facts.name: reserve_known
facts.text: Управляющий: половина воды из цистерны идет в бак под верхней террасой. Это запас Сената на сухой год, открыть его может только Архонт.

facts.name: valve_read
facts.text: Верхняя терраса: цистерна двора сливает воду в каменный бак. На его приемном патрубке пустой фланец, где раньше стоял водомер.

facts.name: canal_matches
facts.text: Сколько Агнес налила водовозам Чаши, столько дошло до желоба Мирелы. Счетчик — вторая половина, и вы его прочли.

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^The bar of the last fort before the empty road smells of diesel and wet wool. ","#","^place: The southern outpost ","/#","#","^img: road_bar","/#","
","^You sit with your back to the wall, which is how you've sat for thirty years. The <term=keepers>Keepers</term> who hold this fort write down every truck through the gate and every man through the bar door. You're in their book as a name and a night's rent, nothing more.","
","^Two weeks ago you drove a truck up the north road that is now a black patch beside a crater. Somebody had buried a mine for somebody else's wheels, and yours were first. A crew of salvagers came out from <term=the_yards>the Yards</term> to strip what was left, and they gave you a ride south on top of the scrap. They talked the whole way about an old hauler and the woman who drives it. ","#","^page","/#","
","^The fort's yard sold you a scout, the smallest thing on four wheels, for nearly all the M's you had left.","
","^At the next table, a woman counts M's out of a roll, brass discs each stamped with an M. She says every sum under her breath, flat and even, the way you'd read a gauge. Her coat has gone pale at the knees. A smear of red wax is still stuck to her cuff, and an hour ago she came down from the Commandant's tower with a clerk bowing her out. Nobody bows to hired drivers. ","#","^img: road_ala ","/#","#","^page","/#","
","^Tibor, the barman, has pulled up a chair across from her. He sells men the way other men sell spare axles.","
","^Rode with Magnus, they say, and the scars say so too. The <term=burnt_drivers>Burnt Drivers</term>, if you're old enough to remember. He takes the jobs nobody else will touch. ","#","^speaker: Tibor ","/#","#","^img: road_geezer","/#","
","^The bar has talked of nothing else since noon. The trailer on the pad carries the cure, they say, for the <term=black_water>black-water sickness</term>, and every man with a gun and a debt has put down his cup to think about that. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_hauler","/#","
","^A woman with a hunter's hands sits down at Ala's table without being asked. She doesn't look at Ala. She looks out of the window at your scout.","
","^That scout's got one driver. One. ","#","^speaker: Vale","/#","
","^Out. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She says it with two fingers lifted, as if shooing a fly. The hunter goes, slowly, and takes her time over the door.","
","^The woman looks out of the window instead of at you. Your scout sits on the pad under the lamp with one gun on its mount, small as a dog. Behind it the hauler fills the rest of the window, a mammoth eighteen-wheeler, and the seal on its trailer door is the same red as the wax on her cuff. ","#","^img: road_hauler ","/#","#","^page","/#","
","^That's what he drives? A toy like that won't last a stretch, fort to fort. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.pitch"},{"pitch":[["^Tibor spreads his hands. Your move, he means. She wants a reason to hire you, and you have two. The burn at your neck says the link went deep in you, and you lived. The bullet scars say you have been shot at and kept driving. Which one does she hear first?","
","ev","str","^Show her the burn on your neck.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Show her the bullet scars.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^link","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch","re":true},{"->":"start.link_scar"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^bullets","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch","re":true},{"->":"start.bullet_scars"},null]}],null],"link_scar":["^You turn your collar down and tilt your head. A linked driver has a socket at the base of the skull. The cable from the seat plugs into it, and the truck answers like an arm. Around yours runs a ring of thick pale skin, where the flesh once cooked around the metal.","
","^When she bent over the M's you saw her own socket under her hair, small and clean. She looks at yours a good while. Her mouth tightens, and it isn't pity.","
","^Linked. Deeper than I am. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She doesn't need you to open your shirt. The old holes show through the torn cloth at your ribs, and she counts them anyway. ",{"->":".^.^.both"},"
",null],"bullet_scars":["^You push up a sleeve, then open your shirt. Ribs, shoulder, forearm. Somebody started counting the holes once, and you stopped.","
","^Ala counts them for you. Her lips move on every one.","
","^Six. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^You shrug your shirt closed, and your collar slips. The ring of old burn around the socket at the base of your skull shows, where a seat's cable plugs in. She looks at it a good while. ",{"->":".^.^.both"},"
",null],"both":["#","^checkpoint: start.both","/#","ev",{"VAR?":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^link","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ It's the burn she's been reading, you can tell. The bullets are only a bonus. ",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^bullets","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ It's the bullets she's been counting, you can tell. The burn is a question she hasn't asked yet. ",{"->":".^.^.^.21"},null]}],"nop","
","^So you've been burned and shot, and you still drive a toy. Why? ","#","^speaker: Ala ","/#","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_geezer","/#","
","^She isn't being cruel. She's pricing you.","
","^Fair question. Two weeks ago, on the road north of here, you drove a truck three times the size of this one. The ground under the front axle went up, and there was one white second. Then you were lying in a ditch, watching your cab burn while the link in your neck still hummed, as if the truck were calling you back in. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You should have been dead in that ditch, and you've been sore about it since.","
","^You tell her so, in about that many words. The truck blew up on a mine. You didn't. The scout was what the yard had left, and a small truck is quick, and sees trouble before trouble sees it.","
","^Ala listens with her chin on her fist. Tibor tries to look like he planned all this. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Fine. Ask what you want. I'll answer what I answer. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.hub"},null],"hub":["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","^Ala stacks her M's in front of her and waits. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.menu"},null],"menu":[["ev","str","^What does it pay?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_pay"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^What's in the trailer?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_trailer"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why north?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_north"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who's coming for the truck?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_who"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Hold out for more.","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_pay"},{"VAR?":"walked_out"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Sign on.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_pay","re":true},"^I drive the hauler. You ride ahead and take what comes. I pay by the stretch, fort to fort: ","ev",1,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^ M's for the first, and ","ev",2,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},1,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"-","out","/ev","^ more for each stretch after that. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^Fuel, repairs, guns, tires: they come out of that, for my rig and for yours. It covers both, if you're careful. The first stretch's fuel comes out of what you have left. After that, the pay carries you. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She pushes three stacks across the table with one finger, to show you what the first three stretches pay: ","ev",1,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^, ","ev",2,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^, ","ev",3,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^. It is only a demonstration. The M's are paid at the far gate.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_trailer","re":true},"^Sealed. The Commandant's wax. That's all I'll say, and it's all the Commandant said to me. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She says it too quickly. Tibor, for once, has nothing to add.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_north","re":true},"^Somebody's waiting on it. No more questions than that. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She says it like something she has said many times, and it sounds like a dodge.","
","^Tibor suddenly finds something interesting in his hands. He sold you the job, not the road.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_who","re":true},"^<term=blackwell>Blackwell</term> wants that truck. The refinery posted a reward in diesel for the crates, and nobody there cares what state the driver's in. ","#","^speaker: Tibor","/#","
","^And half this bar thinks there's a cure in there. Those would come for it with no reward at all. ","#","^speaker: Tibor","/#","
","^Ala doesn't correct him. She turns her cuff over so the wax doesn't show.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"walked_out","re":true},"^You tell her it isn't enough, and you push your chair back.","
","^Nobody pays more. The ones who'd pay more for that trailer want the trailer, not the man who drives it. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She still doesn't look up. Ala is still counting, and Tibor is still smiling.","
","^I'd have thought less of you if you hadn't tried. The offer is the offer. Sit down. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ala_hired","re":true},"^You put your hand flat on the table, and Ala puts hers over it for a second, which is how deals are done here.","
","^I know who you rode with. I don't care. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She says it loud enough for the whole bar, and the whole bar hears it. She slides Tibor his finder's fee without looking, and he is gone before the two of you have let go.","
","^First stretch at dawn. You're paid at the next fort's gate. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She goes out to the hauler. You go out to your scout and check the wheel nuts on every wheel. A loose nut will put a wheel in the ditch. Then you sleep.","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_pay"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_north"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_who"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_trailer"},false,{"VAR=":"walked_out"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

ru.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^В баре последнего форта перед пустой дорогой пахнет дизелем и мокрой шерстью. ","#","^place: Южный пост ","/#","#","^img: road_bar","/#","
","^Вы сидите спиной к стене — так вы сидите уже тридцать лет. <term=keepers>Хранители</term>, которые держат этот форт, записывают каждый грузовик в воротах и каждого человека в дверях бара. В их книге вы значитесь строчкой с именем да платой за ночлег, не больше.","
","^Две недели назад под вашим грузовиком на северной дороге рванула мина: теперь там лишь черное пятно у воронки. Кто-то зарыл её под чужие колеса, но первыми оказались ваши. Бригада мусорщиков приехала из <term=the_yards>Дворов</term> обобрать то, что осталось, и подвезла вас на юг прямо на груде лома. Всю дорогу они говорили про старый тягач и женщину за его рулем. ","#","^page","/#","
","^На площадке форта вам продали разведчика — самую мелкую четырехколесную машину — почти за все оставшиеся монеты.","
","^За соседним столом женщина отсчитывает монеты из свертка — латунные кружки с выбитой буквой М. Счет она цедит вполголоса, ровно и сухо, словно показания счетчика снимает. Пальто на коленях совсем вытерлось. К манжете присохла капля красного сургуча, а час назад она спустилась из башни коменданта, и писарь провожал её чуть ли не с поклонами. Наемным водителям никто не кланяется. ","#","^img: road_ala ","/#","#","^page","/#","
","^Бармен Тибор придвинул стул и сел напротив нее. Людьми он торгует так же, как другие — запасными мостами.","
","^Говорят, ходил с Магнусом, да и по шрамам видно. Из <term=burnt_drivers>Обожженных</term>, если память не изменяет. Берется за работу, к которой другие и близко не подойдут. ","#","^speaker: Тибор ","/#","#","^img: road_geezer","/#","
","^В баре с полудня только об этом и говорят. В прицепе на площадке везут лекарство от <term=black_water>болезни черной воды</term>, и каждый, у кого есть пушка и долги, замер над кружкой, прикидывая шансы. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_hauler","/#","
","^За стол к Але без спроса подсаживается женщина с хваткой охотницы — Вейл. На Алу она даже не смотрит — глядит в окно на вашего разведчика.","
","^У этого разведчика один водитель. Один. ","#","^speaker: Вейл","/#","
","^Вон. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она цедит это, шевельнув двумя пальцами, словно муху отгоняет. Охотница уходит, не спеша, задерживаясь у двери.","
","^Ала смотрит в окно, а не на вас. На площадке под фонарем ждет ваш разведчик с одной пушкой на креплении, мелкий, как собака. За ним всё окно заслоняет тяжелый многоосный тягач, и пломба на двери прицепа — того же красного цвета, что и сургуч на её манжете. ","#","^img: road_hauler ","/#","#","^page","/#","
","^И на этом он ездит? Такая игрушка не выдержит и одного перегона между фортами. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.pitch"},{"pitch":[["^Тибор разводит руками: твой ход. Ей нужен повод нанять вас, и у вас их два. Ожог на шее говорит, что кабель сцепки сидел в вас глубоко, но вы выжили. Пулевые шрамы говорят, что по вам стреляли, а вы не бросали руль. Что показать первым?","
","ev","str","^Показать ожог на шее.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Показать пулевые шрамы.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^link","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch","re":true},{"->":"start.link_scar"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^bullets","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch","re":true},{"->":"start.bullet_scars"},null]}],null],"link_scar":["^Вы отворачиваете воротник и наклоняете голову. У тех, кто водит в сцепке, в затылок вживлен разъем. Кабель от кресла подключается к нему, и грузовик слушается как собственная рука. Вокруг разъема тянется кольцо толстой бледной кожи — там, где плоть когда-то запеклась вокруг металла.","
","^Когда она склонялась над монетами, под волосами мелькнул её собственный разъем, аккуратный и чистый. На ваш рубец она смотрит долго. Губы сжаты, но жалости в этом взгляде нет ни капли.","
","^В сцепке. И сидел глубже, чем у меня. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Расстегивать рубаху незачем. Старые отметины видны сквозь рваную ткань на ребрах, и она все равно их пересчитывает. ",{"->":".^.^.both"},"
",null],"bullet_scars":["^Вы задираете рукав, затем распахиваете рубаху. Ребра, плечо, предплечье. Кто-то однажды принялся считать дыры, но счет пришлось оборвать.","
","^Ала считает за вас. Её губы шевелятся на каждой отметине.","
","^Шесть. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Вы запахиваете рубаху, но воротник съезжает. Становится виден старый ожог вокруг разъема в затылке, куда входит кабель от кресла. Она долго смотрит на него. ",{"->":".^.^.both"},"
",null],"both":["#","^checkpoint: start.both","/#","ev",{"VAR?":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^link","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Сразу видно, что читает она именно ожог. Пули — лишь довесок. ",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^bullets","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Сразу видно, что считала она именно пули. Ожог — вопрос, который она пока не задала. ",{"->":".^.^.^.21"},null]}],"nop","
","^Ожоги, пули, и при этом держишься за эту игрушку. Почему? ","#","^speaker: Ала ","/#","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_geezer","/#","
","^Она не издевается. Она приценивается.","
","^Резонный вопрос. Две недели назад на северной дороге под вашей машиной — втрое больше этой — взлетела на воздух земля под передним мостом, и на миг всё побелело. Потом вы уже лежали в канаве и смотрели, как полыхает кабина, а сцепка в затылке всё гудела, будто машина звала вас обратно. ","#","^page","/#","
","^В той канаве и следовало остаться. С тех пор эта мысль не дает покоя.","
","^Примерно так вы ей и говорите, без лишних слов: грузовик подорвался на мине, вы — нет. Разведчик был единственным, что нашлось на площадке, а юркая машина замечает беду раньше, чем беда заметит её.","
","^Ала слушает, подперев кулаком подбородок. Тибор пытается сделать вид, будто так всё и задумывал. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Ладно. Спрашивай, что хочешь. Отвечу то, что сочту нужным. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.hub"},null],"hub":["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","^Ала складывает монеты столбиками перед собой и ждет. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.menu"},null],"menu":[["ev","str","^Сколько платишь?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_pay"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что в прицепе?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_trailer"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Почему на север?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_north"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Кто охотится за грузовиком?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_who"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Потребовать больше.","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_pay"},{"VAR?":"walked_out"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ударить по рукам.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_pay","re":true},"^Я веду тягач. Ты идешь впереди и принимаешь удар на себя. Плачу за каждый перегон между фортами: ","ev",1,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^ М за первый и плюс по ","ev",2,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},1,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"-","out","/ev","^ М за каждый следующий. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Топливо, ремонт, пушки, резина — всё из этой доли, и на мою машину, и на твою. Если считать с умом, хватит на обе. Топливо на первый перегон берешь из своих остатков. Дальше протянешь на расчете. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она одним пальцем пододвигает по столу три столбика, показывая плату за первые три перегона: ","ev",1,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^, ","ev",2,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^, ","ev",3,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^. Но это лишь для наглядности: расчет только у дальних ворот.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_trailer","re":true},"^Опечатан. Сургуч коменданта. Больше я ничего не скажу, да и сама комендант мне большего не сказала. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Отрезала она это чересчур поспешно. Тибору на этот раз добавить нечего.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_north","re":true},"^Там ждут этот груз. Без лишних расспросов. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Фраза звучит заученно, как чистая отмазка.","
","^Тибор тут же опускает взгляд и делает вид, что занят своими пальцами. Он нашел вам работу, а отвечать за дорогу не нанимался.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_who","re":true},"^<term=blackwell>Блэквуду</term> нужен этот грузовик. Завод назначил награду соляркой за ящики, и никому там нет дела, живым останется водитель или нет. ","#","^speaker: Тибор","/#","
","^А половина этого бара думает, что внутри лекарство. Эти полезут за ним вообще без всякой награды. ","#","^speaker: Тибор","/#","
","^Ала не спорит. Она подворачивает манжету, пряча сургуч.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"walked_out","re":true},"^Вы говорите, что этого мало, и отодвигаете стул.","
","^Больше никто не заплатит. А те, кто заплатил бы за этот прицеп больше, хотят прицеп, а не того, кто за рулем. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она всё так же не поднимает глаз. Ала всё так же считает, а Тибор всё так же улыбается.","
","^Не попробовал бы поторговаться — я бы о тебе хуже подумала. Предложение прежнее. Садись. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ala_hired","re":true},"^Вы кладете ладонь на стол, и Ала на секунду накрывает её своей — так здесь скрепляют сделку.","
","^Я знаю, с кем приходилось ходить. Мне плевать. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она говорит это громко, на весь зал, и бар слышит каждое слово. Не глядя, она сдвигает Тибору его долю за наводку, и тот исчезает прежде, чем вы успеваете разнять руки.","
","^Первый перегон на рассвете. Расчет — у ворот следующего форта. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она уходит к тягачу. Вы идете к разведчику и проверяете гайки на каждом колесе. Ослабнет гайка, и колесо улетит в канаву. Затем сон.","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_pay"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_north"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_who"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_trailer"},false,{"VAR=":"walked_out"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^The first fort north is a wall, a gate and a yard full of trucks waiting to be counted. ","#","^place: The first outpost ","/#","#","^img: road_hauler","/#","
","^Hunters came out of the badlands this morning, and both trucks got through. Afterward you sat with your hands on the wheel and waited to feel something. What came was closer to disappointment than to anything else. You don't look at that too long.","
","^The fort's clerk pays Ala the stretch's fee across his counter, and she counts your pay into your hand out loud: ","ev",1,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^ M's, one disc at a time, as if someone might argue. Every sum comes out level. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.tougher"},{"tougher":["#","^checkpoint: start.tougher","/#","ev",{"VAR?":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^link","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ A linked driver, and you're still the one driving when the shooting stops. ","#","^speaker: Ala ",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],"nop","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^bullets","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Six holes in you, and you keep being the one still driving. ","#","^speaker: Ala ",{"->":".^.^.^.22"},null]}],"nop","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ You keep being the one still driving. ","#","^speaker: Ala ",{"->":".^.^.^.33"},null]}],"nop","/#","
","^You're tougher than you look. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She closes your fingers over the last M and does not look away. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You kept my truck on the road. So I'm asking once. The ring scar on your neck. What happened to your link? ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.ask"},null],"ask":[["^She waits. Behind her the Keepers count trucks through the gate, one by one, in a flat voice.","
","ev","str","^A seat was burning. I pulled the plug out myself.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Old wound.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Say nothing.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^told","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"ring_told","re":true},{"->":"start.told"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^dodged","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"ring_told","re":true},{"->":"start.dodged"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^silent","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"ring_told","re":true},{"->":"start.silent"},null]}],null],"told":["^That fire is years older than the mine that took your last truck. You haven't told it to anyone, and it comes out flat, as if somebody else said it.","
","^Ala takes it in without looking away. She doesn't say she's sorry.","
","^A burning seat, and you tore the plug out yourself. Not much of a story. It'll do. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^A link seat is fitted to the man who sits in it. The wrong man in one burns, and you were the wrong man. You don't say that part.","
",{"->":".^.^.maya"},null],"dodged":["^Old, yes. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She turns the word over like an M she isn't sure about.","
","^I said once. I meant once. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.maya"},null],"silent":["^You look at the gate, and then at your own boots. The Keepers count another truck in.","
","^She waits the length of one count. Then another.","
","^Fine. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^It is not quite a refusal and not quite a favor.","
",{"->":".^.^.maya"},null],"maya":["^She puts the rest of the roll away, and for once she doesn't count it. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_ala","/#","
","^Since I asked you something, here is what I pay for. There's a girl at <term=the_yards>the Yards</term>, Maya, twelve years old. She drank the cheap water <term=blackwell>Blackwell</term> sold us this spring, and the fever hasn't broken. Water from the valley breaks it. Nothing else does. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She says it level, like a sum. It is the first thing she has told you that costs her something.","
","^The salvagers who gave you the ride south said something about Ala herself, over the noise of the scrap. They said her own father died on this road. It was sixteen years ago, they said, and nobody at the Yards would say how. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.father"},null],"father":[["^Ala is looking at the gate again.","
","ev","str","^The salvagers said your father died on the road.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Leave it.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"father_told","re":true},{"->":"start.asked"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"start.left"},null]}],null],"asked":["^She doesn't flinch. She turns her cuff over to hide the wax.","
","^Jon. A linked tanker driver, like me. He was in the first water convoy Blackwell ever sent out. The <term=burnt_drivers>Burnt Drivers</term> took it at the pass, sixteen years ago, and nobody walked away. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^You know the pass. You know which wall of it the sun leaves first, and where a convoy has to slow for the bend. You look at the Keepers' gate and count the trucks with them, one, two, three.","
","^That's all of it. I don't say it twice. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.close"},null],"left":["^You don't ask. She nods at the gate, grateful and not saying so.","
",{"->":".^.^.close"},null],"close":["#","^checkpoint: start.close","/#","^That evening the fort bar is full of drivers and smoke. Old bounty notices hang behind it, ink gone brown, with faces drawn on them, men the forts once wanted dead. You look them over out of habit, the way you check your tires. ","#","^page","/#","
","^The barman looks at you the way he looks at everyone, for what you might spend. He doesn't know your face. You pay for a cup anyway.","
","^Across the room Ala is working out the next stretch's fuel on the back of a notice. She does it twice. ","ev",{"VAR?":"father_told"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ She does it a third time, and her pencil stops over one line.",{"->":".^.^.^.15"},null]}],"nop","^ ","#","^page","/#","
","end",null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

ru.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Первый форт на севере — это стена, ворота и двор, забитый грузовиками в очереди на досмотр. ","#","^place: Первый пост ","/#","#","^img: road_hauler","/#","
","^Утром из пустошей вылетели охотники, но обе машины пробились. А потом вы сидели, сжимая руль, и ждали, шевельнется ли хоть что-то внутри. Отозвалась разве что глухая досада. Долго разбираться в себе некогда.","
","^Писарь форта через стойку отдает Але плату за перегон, и она отсчитывает вам в руку вашу долю: ","ev",1,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^ М, по одному кружку, вслух, словно кто-то станет спорить. Каждое число звучит сухо и ровно. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.tougher"},{"tougher":["#","^checkpoint: start.tougher","/#","ev",{"VAR?":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^link","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ В сцепке, а после перестрелки всё равно остаешься за рулем. ","#","^speaker: Ала ",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],"nop","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^bullets","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Шесть дыр в теле, а всё равно остаешься за рулем. ","#","^speaker: Ала ",{"->":".^.^.^.22"},null]}],"nop","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ И всё равно остаешься за рулем. ","#","^speaker: Ала ",{"->":".^.^.^.33"},null]}],"nop","/#","
","^Крепче, чем кажется со стороны. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она сжимает ваши пальцы вокруг последней монеты и не отводит глаз. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Мой тягач уцелел только благодаря тебе. Так что спрошу один раз. Кольцевой шрам на шее. Что случилось со сцепкой? ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.ask"},null],"ask":[["^Она ждет. За её спиной Хранители монотонно считают грузовики в воротах, один за другим.","
","ev","str","^Кресло горело. Штекер пришлось выдернуть своими руками.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Старая рана.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Промолчать.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^told","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"ring_told","re":true},{"->":"start.told"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^dodged","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"ring_told","re":true},{"->":"start.dodged"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^silent","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"ring_told","re":true},{"->":"start.silent"},null]}],null],"told":["^Тот пожар случился на много лет раньше мины, разнесшей ваш последний грузовик. Рассказывать об этом никому не приходилось, и слова звучат сухо, будто говорит кто-то другой.","
","^Ала слушает, не отводя взгляда. Жалеть она и не думает.","
","^Горящее кресло, а штекер вырван своими руками. Негусто для рассказа. Но сойдет. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Кресло со сцепкой подгоняют под того, кто в нем сидит. Чужой человек в таком кресле горит, и этим чужим довелось оказаться вам. Об этой части рассказа вы молчите.","
",{"->":".^.^.maya"},null],"dodged":["^Старая, значит. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она примеривается к этому слову, будто крутит в пальцах монету, в которой не уверена.","
","^Я сказала — один раз. Значит, один раз. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.maya"},null],"silent":["^Вы смотрите на ворота, потом на свои сапоги. Хранители впускают очередной грузовик.","
","^Она выдерживает паузу на один счет. Потом на другой.","
","^Ладно. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^В этом нет ни явного отказа, ни особого расположения.","
",{"->":".^.^.maya"},null],"maya":["^Она убирает остаток свертка и на этот раз не пересчитывает его. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_ala","/#","
","^Раз уж с меня был вопрос, вот за что я плачу. Во <term=the_yards>Дворах</term> осталась девочка, Майя, двенадцать лет. Весной она пила дешевую воду, которую нам продал <term=blackwell>Блэквуд</term>, и лихорадка не спадает. Сбить её может только вода из долины. Больше ничто. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она говорит это сухо и ровно, словно ведет подсчет. Это первое из сказанного ею, что дается ей нелегко.","
","^Мусорщики, подвозившие вас на юг, сквозь грохот лома говорили кое-что о самой Але. Сказали, её собственный отец погиб на этой дороге. Шестнадцать лет назад, и во Дворах никто не станет рассказывать, как именно. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.father"},null],"father":[["^Ала снова смотрит на ворота.","
","ev","str","^Мусорщики говорили, что твой отец погиб на дороге.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Не лезть с расспросами.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"father_told","re":true},{"->":"start.asked"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"start.left"},null]}],null],"asked":["^Она не вздрагивает. Только подворачивает манжету, пряча сургуч.","
","^Джон. Водитель цистерны в сцепке, как и я. Он шел в самом первом водовозном конвое Блэквуда. <term=burnt_drivers>Обожженные</term> перебили их на перевале шестнадцать лет назад, и живым не ушел никто. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Вам знаком этот перевал. Известно, какую стену солнце покидает первой и где конвою приходится сбавлять ход перед поворотом. Вы смотрите на ворота Хранителей и считаете грузовики вместе с ними: раз, два, три.","
","^Вот и всё. Дважды повторять не стану. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.close"},null],"left":["^Вы не спрашиваете. Она кивает на ворота, с благодарностью, хоть и без слов.","
",{"->":".^.^.close"},null],"close":["#","^checkpoint: start.close","/#","^Вечером в баре форта полно водителей и дыма. За стойкой висят старые объявления о награде с побуревшими чернилами — лица тех, за чью смерть коменданты когда-то платили. Вы разглядываете их по привычке, словно проверяете шины. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Бармен смотрит на вас так же, как на всех остальных: прикидывая, сколько вы можете потратить. Вашего лица он не знает. Вы все равно платите за кружку.","
","^В углу Ала на обороте листка прикидывает расход топлива на следующий перегон. И пересчитывает дважды. ","ev",{"VAR?":"father_told"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Считает и в третий раз, и карандаш замирает над одной строчкой.",{"->":".^.^.^.15"},null]}],"nop","^ ","#","^page","/#","
","end",null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^The twelfth fort keeps a lamp burning on every wall all night. ","#","^place: The twelfth outpost ","/#","#","^img: road_hauler","/#","
","^This stretch nearly killed you both. The hauler's left side is stripped to the frame, and your scout is running on one good tire. You didn't expect to live through it. You never do.","
","^Ala counts the stretch's pay into your hand out loud, ","ev",12,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^ M's, one disc at a time, and her hands are not steady. Then she brings the fort's relay slips to where you sit on the scout's bumper. ","#","^page","/#","
","^The first says Hedda Vell shut Blackwell's gates and sent every fort her confession. She sold the Yards bad water and knew it, it says. She was afraid, and that was all the truth she had left. There is no word on the reward. The hunters are owed diesel by a town that won't open to them, and nobody has told them to stop. They will keep coming, and the bar still says the trailer holds the cure. ","#","^page","/#","
","^The second says the people are on the road. The <term=keepers>Keepers</term> pass them north from fort to fort and feed them where they stop. The Warden will open Northgate's gate when they come. A hunter named Vale, who hunted this truck for eight stretches and lost two trucks to it, turned back with her one truck and holds the road behind them. The slip quotes her. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_walkers","/#","
","^Any crew wants these families, they come through me first. ","#","^speaker: Vale","/#","
","^The last line of the slip is short. Maya rides with them, days back, and there is not a gun among them. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.free_to_go"},{"free_to_go":["^There is a last slip, from the Keepers' own relay. Ala reads it out in the voice she uses for sums. ","#","^page","/#","
","^The Keepers say your escort wears a Burnt Driver's burn. Keep the road clear for the families behind you. ","#","^speaker: Keepers' relay","/#","
","^Ala folds the slips and puts them away. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You're paid up, and by the deal you're free to go. I won't hold you. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She doesn't say it as if she means it. She says it as if she's reading it.","
",{"->":".^.^.fire"},null],"fire":["#","^checkpoint: start.fire","/#","^You don't answer. You look at the lamp on the wall, and the lamp makes you think of fire, and then of other fire. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_tankline","/#","
","^A tank line, years ago: a row of dead army trucks left in the dust where the army left them. Every truck still had its link seat, fitted to the man who drove it and died in it. Plug into a seat that wasn't yours, and it burned you. You took the first one anyway, because you were Magnus, and Magnus took what he wanted. ","#","^page","/#","
","^The seat took hold of your neck and began to cook the socket out of you. You heard yourself scream.","
","^Your drivers followed you into the other seats, one truck after another, because Magnus had gone first and Magnus was never wrong. By the time you screamed, each was already plugged into a seat that was not his. In the next truck, close enough to hear through both hulls, sat the youngest, barely twenty, burning, one of your own. He was screaming too, and then he was saying a name. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Magnus! The plug! Magnus! ","#","^speaker: Burnt Driver","/#","
","^You tore the plug out of your own seat with both hands. That left the ring in your neck. You didn't go back for the boy. You walked out into the badlands, and you have been walking away ever since. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Before the tank line there was the pass, in the years when Magnus never lost. A line of tankers slowed for the bend, and the first cab had a linked man in it, who looked up at the ridge. You gave the order. Afterward you walked down the line, and not one of the cabs had a living man in it. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.ask"},null],"ask":[["#","^checkpoint: start.ask","/#","^Ala has been watching your face for a long time. She doesn't know what she's looking at. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_ala","/#","
","^At the eighth fort, an old Keeper looked at your neck and said he knew a man with a burn like that. Now the Keepers say that burn is a Burnt Driver's. My father was driving that convoy at the pass. Were you there when it was taken? ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","ev","str","^I rode with the Burnt Drivers. Your father died to us.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^A man I knew. He's dead.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^I led them. My name was Magnus.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^burnt","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"ala_knows","re":true},{"->":"start.burnt"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^dead","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"ala_knows","re":true},{"->":"start.dead"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^magnus","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"ala_knows","re":true},{"->":"start.magnus"},null]}],null],"burnt":["^You say it straight, without the name. You rode with the Burnt Drivers, and they took and killed on this road until the winter that ended them. Her father was one of the ones they killed.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"father_told"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^I told you how he died. I didn't tell you that I'd know the man if I met him. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.7"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Sixteen years. I was eighteen, at the Yards, when the news came. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.7"},null]}],"nop","
","^She says it as a plain fact.","
","^I won't ask whether you were at the pass. If you were, tell me before you leave, not after. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ring_told"},"str","^told","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You told me about a burning seat, and now this. It adds up. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.25"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^So that's what the scar is. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.25"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.pass_pick"},null],"pass_pick":[["ev","str","^I was at the pass.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Say nothing.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"pass_said","re":true},"^You say it and nothing else. You don't say whose order, and she doesn't ask. Her hand closes on her cuff, and opens again.","
","^Then you owe me the rest. Not tonight. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":"start.stay"},null],"c-1":["
","^You say nothing, and she lets you.","
",{"->":"start.stay"},null]}],null],"dead":["^A man you knew, you say, and he's dead. The man the Keeper knew is dead, in a way. It is the truest lie you have.","
","^There are a lot of those on this road. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^But your hand did not shake at a stranger. She lets it lie, because the road is long and she has learned to leave things where they are.","
",{"->":".^.^.stay"},null],"magnus":["^You say it, and it sits between you on the step.","
","^Ala doesn't move for a long time.","
","^Magnus burned in his seat at the tank line. Tibor tells it every night, and the barmen of six forts. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^Yes, you say. They tell it very well.","
","^She looks at the scar. She looks at your hands. She does not ask about the pass, and you do not say it. You both know where the road narrows.","
",{"->":".^.^.stay"},null],"stay":["#","^checkpoint: start.stay","/#","^She should send you away. You can see her know it, and you can see her do the sum. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Out on the road, days behind, a girl with a fever is riding north among two hundred people with no gun. You are one gun on one good tire. Against what hunts them, that is nothing. It is what there is. ","#","^page","/#","
","^So. Are you riding on? ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.say"},null],"say":[["ev","str","^I'm riding on.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Until Maya drinks from the spring.","/str",{"VAR?":"promised"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Same pay, then.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Say you ought to leave.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^plain","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"stay_said","re":true},"^You say it flat, the way you say everything. She nods once.","
","^I thought so. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":"start.close"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^people","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"stay_said","re":true},"^You said it once, at the fourth fort, and you say it again. Her hands are steadier than they were.","
","^Then we're both fools. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":"start.close"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^pay","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"stay_said","re":true},"^A pause, and then something that is nearly a laugh.","
","^Same pay. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":"start.close"},null],"c-3":["
","ev","str","^left","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"stay_said","re":true},"^You tell her you ought to go. It is true. It just isn't the reason.","
","^Ought to. Not the same as will. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She leaves the gate of the yard standing open behind her, in case. You don't use it.","
",{"->":"start.close"},null]}],null],"close":["#","^checkpoint: start.close","/#","ev",{"VAR?":"ala_knows"},"str","^burnt","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^She looks at the scar again.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pass_said"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ I'm paying the man in front of me, and I'll want the rest of that story. ","#","^speaker: Ala ",{"->":".^.^.^.7"},null]}],"nop","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pass_said"},"!","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ I'm paying the man in front of me, whoever he rode with. ","#","^speaker: Ala ",{"->":".^.^.^.15"},null]}],"nop","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ala_knows"},"str","^dead","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ She doesn't ask who the dead man was. She has learned to leave things where they lie. ",{"->":".^.^.^.21"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ala_knows"},"str","^magnus","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^She puts her hand flat on the step to steady herself.","
","^Then Tibor tells it wrong. Good. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.31"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"hand_shook"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ You remember your hand shaking against the scar at the eighth fort, and you keep it flat on your knee now. ",{"->":".^.^.^.37"},null]}],"nop","
","^Later you sit up on the wall, facing south, where two hundred people are driving in the dark. No lights show on the road, and you look anyway. ","#","^page","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ala_knows"},"str","^dead","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Ala climbs up with one cup, sets it down between you, and says nothing about the dead man. ",{"->":".^.^.^.52"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ala_knows"},"str","^burnt","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Ala climbs up with two cups. She sits a little way off. ",{"->":".^.^.^.62"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ala_knows"},"str","^magnus","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Ala climbs up with two cups and sits close enough to touch.","
","^Tell me the rest some night. Not tonight. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.72"},null]}],"nop","
","^The next stretch pays ","ev",13,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^ M's. Drink first. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","end",null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"stay_said"},false,{"VAR=":"pass_said"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

ru.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^В двенадцатом форте на каждой стене всю ночь горит по фонарю. ","#","^place: Двенадцатый пост ","/#","#","^img: road_hauler","/#","
","^Этот перегон едва не прикончил вас обоих. Левый борт тягача ободран до рамы, а разведчик держится на одном уцелевшем скате. Выжить вы не рассчитывали. Как, впрочем, и всегда.","
","^Ала вслух отсчитывает плату за перегон вам в руку, ","ev",12,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^ М, по одному кружку, и руки её дрожат. Затем приносит листки радиограмм форта туда, где вы сидите на бампере разведчика. ","#","^page","/#","
","^В первой сказано, что Хедда Вэлл заперла ворота Блэквуда и разослала по всем фортам признание. Она продала Дворам дурную воду и знала об этом, говорится там. Ей было страшно, и это вся правда, какая у нее осталась. О награде ни слова. Охотникам задолжал солярку город, который перед ними не откроется, и никто не велел им остановиться. Они будут нападать и дальше, а в баре по-прежнему говорят, что в прицепе лекарство. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Во второй сказано, что люди вышли на дорогу. <term=keepers>Хранители</term> передают их на север от форта к форту и кормят на стоянках. Смотритель откроет ворота Северных Ворот, когда они придут. Охотница по имени Вейл, которая восемь перегонов охотилась за этим тягачом и потеряла на нем два грузовика, развернулась на своей единственной машине и держит дорогу позади них. В радиограмме приводятся её слова. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_walkers","/#","
","^Если какой сброд захочет добраться до этих семей, сначала придется пройти через меня. ","#","^speaker: Вейл","/#","
","^Последняя строчка в листке коротка. Майя едет с ними, на несколько дней пути позади, и у них нет ни единого ствола. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.free_to_go"},{"free_to_go":["^Остался последний листок, из собственного реле Хранителей. Ала зачитывает его сухо и ровно, словно ведет расчет. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Хранители говорят, на твоем конвоире ожог Обожженного. Держи дорогу открытой для семей позади вас. ","#","^speaker: Реле Хранителей","/#","
","^Ала складывает листки и убирает их. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Расчет получен, и по уговору можно уходить. Я не держу. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она говорит это не от души. Она говорит это так, словно читает по бумажке.","
",{"->":".^.^.fire"},null],"fire":["#","^checkpoint: start.fire","/#","^Вы не отвечаете. Вы смотрите на фонарь на стене, и желтый свет заставляет думать об огне, а затем — о совсем другом пламени. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_tankline","/#","
","^Танковый парк много лет назад: вереница мертвых армейских грузовиков в пыли, там, где их бросила армия. В каждой машине оставалось кресло со сцепкой, подогнанное под водителя, который в нем ездил и умер. Подключись к чужому креслу — и оно сожжет заживо. Вы все равно сели в первое из них, потому что вы были Магнусом, а Магнус брал всё, что хотел. ","#","^page","/#","
