","^Кресло вцепилось в шею и принялось вываривать разъем из плоти. Раздался собственный крик.","
","^Водители полезли в остальные кресла вслед за вами, машина за машиной, потому что первым пошел Магнус, а Магнус никогда не ошибался. К тому мигу, когда вырвался крик, каждый уже подключился к чужому креслу. В соседнем грузовике, так близко, что слышно было сквозь оба борта, горел самый молодой, едва за двадцать, один из ваших. Он тоже кричал, а потом позвал по имени. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Магнус! Штекер! Магнус! ","#","^speaker: Обожженный","/#","
","^Штекер из собственного кресла удалось вырвать обеими руками, оставив на шее запекшийся рубец. За парнем возвращаться не довелось. Шаг в пустоши — и этот уход прочь длится до сих пор. ","#","^page","/#","
","^До танкового парка был перевал, в те годы, когда Магнус никогда не проигрывал. Вереница цистерн сбавила ход перед поворотом, и в первой кабине сидел водитель в сцепке, глядевший вверх на гребень. Приказ был отдан. А потом — проход вдоль колонны, и ни в одной из кабин не осталось ни единого живого человека. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.ask"},null],"ask":[["#","^checkpoint: start.ask","/#","^Ала уже долго вглядывается в ваше лицо. Она не понимает, что пытается в нем разглядеть. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_ala","/#","
","^В восьмом форте старый Хранитель посмотрел на твою шею и сказал, что знал человека с таким же ожогом. Теперь Хранители говорят, что это ожог Обожженного. Мой отец вел тот конвой на перевале. Довелось быть там, когда его взяли? ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","ev","str","^Довелось ходить с Обожженными. Твой отец погиб от наших рук.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Один знакомый. Он мертв.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Довелось их возглавлять. Меня звали Магнус.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^burnt","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"ala_knows","re":true},{"->":"start.burnt"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^dead","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"ala_knows","re":true},{"->":"start.dead"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^magnus","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"ala_knows","re":true},{"->":"start.magnus"},null]}],null],"burnt":["^Вы говорите прямо, без имени. Довелось ходить с Обожженными, и они грабили и убивали на этой дороге до самой зимы, которая положила им конец. Её отец был одним из тех, кого они убили.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"father_told"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Я говорила тебе, как он погиб. Но не говорила, что узнаю виновного при встрече. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.7"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Шестнадцать лет. Мне было восемнадцать, я была во Дворах, когда пришла весть. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.7"},null]}],"nop","
","^Она говорит об этом буднично, как о простом факте.","
","^Я не стану спрашивать, довелось ли тебе быть на перевале. Если довелось, скажи мне до ухода, а не после. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ring_told"},"str","^told","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Ты уже говорил про горящее кресло, а теперь еще и это. Всё сходится. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.25"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Так вот откуда этот шрам. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.25"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.pass_pick"},null],"pass_pick":[["ev","str","^Довелось быть на перевале.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Промолчать.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"pass_said","re":true},"^Вы произносите это и больше ничего. Вы не говорите, чей был приказ, а она не спрашивает. Её рука сжимает манжету и разжимается снова.","
","^Тогда за тобой должок. Не сегодня. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":"start.stay"},null],"c-1":["
","^Вы молчите, и она не настаивает.","
",{"->":"start.stay"},null]}],null],"dead":["^Один знакомый, говорите вы, и он мертв. Тот, кого знал Хранитель, в каком-то смысле мертв. Это самая честная ложь, на какую вы способны.","
","^На этой дороге таких хватает. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Но при виде чужака рука бы не дрожала. Она оставляет это при вас, потому что дорога длинная, а она научилась оставлять прошлое там, где оно лежит.","
",{"->":".^.^.stay"},null],"magnus":["^Вы произносите это, и слова повисают между вами на подножке.","
","^Ала долго не шевелится.","
","^Магнус сгорел в своем кресле в танковом парке. Тибор рассказывает об этом каждый вечер, как и бармены шести фортов. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^— Да, — говорите вы. — Рассказывать они умеют складно.","
","^Она смотрит на шрам. Смотрит на ваши руки. Она не спрашивает про перевал, а вы не говорите о нем. Вы оба знаете, где сужается дорога.","
",{"->":".^.^.stay"},null],"stay":["#","^checkpoint: start.stay","/#","^Ей следовало бы прогнать вас прочь. Она прекрасно это понимает, и по глазам заметно, как она всё просчитывает. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Там, на темной дороге, на несколько дней пути позади, девочка в лихорадке едет на север среди двух сотен безоружных людей. У вас — одна пушка на одном целом колесе. Против стаи охотников это ничто. Но больше никого нет. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Ну что. Едем дальше? ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.say"},null],"say":[["ev","str","^Едем дальше.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Пока Майя не напьется из источника.","/str",{"VAR?":"promised"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Тогда за ту же плату.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Сказать, что следовало бы уйти.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^plain","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"stay_said","re":true},"^Вы говорите это сухо, как и всё на свете. Она коротко кивает.","
","^Я так и думала. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":"start.close"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^people","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"stay_said","re":true},"^Эти слова вы уже говорили в четвертом форте, и повторяете снова. Руки её дрожат уже не так сильно.","
","^Значит, мы оба дураки. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":"start.close"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^pay","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"stay_said","re":true},"^Пауза, а затем звук, почти похожий на смешок.","
","^За ту же плату. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":"start.close"},null],"c-3":["
","ev","str","^left","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"stay_said","re":true},"^Вы говорите, что следовало бы уйти. Это правда. Только причина не в этом.","
","^Следовало бы. Но это не значит, что уйдешь. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она оставляет за собой ворота двора открытыми, на всякий случай. Вы ими не пользуетесь.","
",{"->":"start.close"},null]}],null],"close":["#","^checkpoint: start.close","/#","ev",{"VAR?":"ala_knows"},"str","^burnt","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Она снова смотрит на шрам.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pass_said"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Я плачу тому, кто стоит передо мной, и остаток этой истории ты мне ещё расскажешь. ","#","^speaker: Ала ",{"->":".^.^.^.7"},null]}],"nop","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pass_said"},"!","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Я плачу тому, кто стоит передо мной, с кем бы он ни ходил в прошлом. ","#","^speaker: Ала ",{"->":".^.^.^.15"},null]}],"nop","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ala_knows"},"str","^dead","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Она не спрашивает, кем был покойник. Она научилась оставлять прошлое там, где оно лежит. ",{"->":".^.^.^.21"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ala_knows"},"str","^magnus","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Она кладет ладонь на подножку, чтобы опереться.","
","^Значит, Тибор врет. И хорошо. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.31"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"hand_shook"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Вы помните, как в восьмом форте пальцы дрожали на ожоге, и теперь держите ладонь прижатой к колену. ",{"->":".^.^.^.37"},null]}],"nop","
","^Позже вы сидите на стене, глядя на юг, где в темноте едут две сотни людей. Никаких огней на дороге не видно, но вы все равно вглядываетесь. ","#","^page","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ala_knows"},"str","^dead","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Ала поднимается на стену с одной кружкой, ставит её между вами и ничего не говорит о покойнике. ",{"->":".^.^.^.52"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ala_knows"},"str","^burnt","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Ала поднимается на стену с двумя кружками. Она садится чуть поодаль. ",{"->":".^.^.^.62"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ala_knows"},"str","^magnus","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Ала поднимается на стену с двумя кружками и садится вплотную, плечом к плечу.","
","^Расскажешь остальное как-нибудь потом. Не сегодня. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.72"},null]}],"nop","
","^За следующий перегон причитается ","ev",13,{"x()":"stretch_pay","exArgs":1},"out","/ev","^ М. Сначала выпей. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","end",null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"stay_said"},false,{"VAR=":"pass_said"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^The fourth fort has a water cistern on its roof and a Keeper asleep beside it. ","#","^place: The fourth outpost ","/#","#","^img: road_hauler","/#","
","^The hunters came two at a time on the way up, and both trucks got through. The hauler's cab still has its glass.","
","^Ala climbs down from the hauler and counts the stretch's pay into your hand out loud, quickly, without her usual care. Her eyes keep going to your scout. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.death_machine"},{"death_machine":[["#","^checkpoint: start.death_machine","/#","^Four stretches, and you're always the one still rolling when it's over. How the hell are you such a death machine? ","#","^speaker: Ala ","/#","#","^img: road_ala","/#","
","^She isn't joking. She's measuring what she bought.","
","ev","str","^Thirty years of this road.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^I rode with hard men. Did things I'm still running from.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^What Tibor told you: I rode with Magnus.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Say nothing.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^road","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"death_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.road"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^hard_men","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"death_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.hard_men"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^magnus","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"death_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.magnus"},null],"c-3":["
","ev","str","^silent","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"death_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.silent"},null]}],null],"road":["^Thirty years of this road teaches you things, you tell her. Where a driver looks before he fires. How a truck leans before it turns.","
","^That's not an answer. That's a calendar. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ring_told"},"str","^told","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^She taps the back of her own neck, where yours is burned.","
","^A man who pulls his own plug didn't learn that from a calendar. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.15"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.hub_intro"},null],"hard_men":["^It comes out before you have weighed it. Hard men, you say, and things you did beside them, and you are still running, and that is the whole of it.","
","^Running from what? ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^You look at the road. She lets the road be the answer, and she doesn't ask twice.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"father_told"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Her hand has gone to her cuff. She doesn't turn it over. ",{"->":".^.^.^.13"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.hub_intro"},null],"magnus":["^Tibor told me that one. Every bar on this road has three men who rode with Magnus. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^You have said that sentence in a lot of bars. You say it as flatly as a road sign.","
","^She lets it sit. She doesn't say whether she believes it. She looks at your hands for a while, and then at your neck.","
",{"->":".^.^.hub_intro"},null],"silent":["^You say nothing. A good truck can sit in silence, and so can a good driver.","
","^Ala looks at you for a while. Then she nods slowly, as if silence were an answer of a kind. It is.","
",{"->":".^.^.hub_intro"},null],"hub_intro":["^She sits down on the hauler's step. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_hauler","/#","
","^Ask, if you're going to. I'll answer what I answer. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.hub"},null],"hub":["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","^She waits. The Keeper on the roof turns over in his sleep. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.menu"},null],"menu":[["ev","str","^What's in the trailer?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_trailer"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Where are we going?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_north"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who pays the hunters?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_hunters"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^That's enough.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_trailer","re":true},"^Books. A dead doctor's journals from the valley, forty years of them. Ilse Marten's, who doctored the whole valley. My mother hid them three years. Then the Commandant read the name on the cover, and now they're sealed in her wax. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She says it like a list she has learned, and she stops before she says what is written in them.","
","^The bar says it's a cure. It's paper. It's what the valley will trade water for, Maya's first and then the Yards'. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_north","re":true},"^<term=northgate>Northgate</term>. A valley at the end of the road, with a spring. Its Warden writes to every fort I pass, through the relay, and he writes politely: turn back. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^I'm not turning back. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_hunters","re":true},"^Hedda Vell. She runs Blackwell, and she posted it herself, in diesel. Whether I come back alive, she doesn't care. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She says the name flatly, like a debt she has carried for years.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^You know more than you did, and the road is no safer for it.","
",{"->":"start.maya"},null]}],null],"maya":["#","^checkpoint: start.maya","/#","^Ala doesn't get up. She looks at the cistern, and then at her hands. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_ala","/#","
","^Maya's fever spiked again on the third night. Sara's slip said she shakes, and she asks for me every hour, and then she asks what the valley looks like. I don't know what to tell her. I've never seen it. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She waits. She isn't asking for anything. That is how you know she wants it.","
",{"->":".^.^.promise"},null],"promise":[["ev","str","^I'll get you there.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Say nothing.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"promised","re":true},"^You hear yourself say it. It isn't a thing you say. You've never said it to anyone, and you know exactly how heavy it is.","
","^Ala looks at you for a long time. She nods once, and doesn't thank you, because a debt like that can't be thanked.","
",{"->":"start.close"},null],"c-1":["
","^You say nothing. It is the safest thing a man like you can say.","
","^She nods, as if she'd expected it, and that is somehow worse.","
",{"->":"start.close"},null]}],null],"close":["^Ala gets up. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Dawn, then. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^You go and check the belts, every one of them. A slack belt will cook your engine. The yard here has a welder who works at night, and you leave him a few M's for the scout's weld.","
","end",null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_trailer"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_north"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_hunters"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

ru.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^На крыше четвертого форта стоит цистерна с водой, и рядом спит Хранитель. ","#","^place: Четвертый пост ","/#","#","^img: road_hauler","/#","
","^По дороге сюда охотники нападали по двое разом, но обе машины пробились. На кабине тягача уцелели даже стекла.","
","^Ала спускается из тягача и вслух отсчитывает плату за перегон вам в ладонь, быстро, без обычной дотошности. Взгляд её то и дело соскальзывает на вашего разведчика. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.death_machine"},{"death_machine":[["#","^checkpoint: start.death_machine","/#","^Четыре перегона, и каждый раз после боя остаешься на ходу. Как, черт тебя дери, ты умудряешься всех перемалывать? ","#","^speaker: Ала ","/#","#","^img: road_ala","/#","
","^Она не шутит. Она прикидывает, за кого заплатила.","
","ev","str","^Тридцать лет на этой дороге.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Довелось ходить с лихими людьми. Творить то, от чего до сих пор приходится бежать.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Правду сказал Тибор: довелось ходить с Магнусом.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Промолчать.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^road","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"death_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.road"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^hard_men","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"death_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.hard_men"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^magnus","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"death_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.magnus"},null],"c-3":["
","ev","str","^silent","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"death_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.silent"},null]}],null],"road":["^Тридцать лет на этой дороге кое-чему учат, говорите вы ей. Куда водитель смотрит перед выстрелом. Как грузовик кренится перед поворотом.","
","^Это не ответ. Это календарь. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"ring_told"},"str","^told","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Она хлопает себя по затылку — там, где у вас ожог.","
","^Человек, который сам выдернул штекер, научился этому не по календарю. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.15"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.hub_intro"},null],"hard_men":["^Слова срываются раньше, чем удается их взвесить. Лихие люди, говорите вы, и дела, творившиеся рядом с ними, и от которых всё ещё приходится бежать, вот и всё.","
","^Бежать от чего? ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Вы смотрите на дорогу. Она принимает дорогу за ответ и не спрашивает дважды.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"father_told"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Её рука потянулась к манжете. Но подворачивать её она не стала. ",{"->":".^.^.^.13"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.hub_intro"},null],"magnus":["^Эту байку мне Тибор заливал. В каждом баре на этой дороге найдутся трое, кто ходил с Магнусом. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Эту фразу вам доводилось бросать во многих барах. Вы произносите её сухо и ровно, словно зачитываете надпись на дорожном столбе.","
","^Она выдерживает паузу. Верит или нет — по лицу не прочесть. С минуту она разглядывает ваши руки, потом переводит взгляд на шею.","
",{"->":".^.^.hub_intro"},null],"silent":["^Вы молчите. Хороший грузовик умеет стоять молча, и хороший водитель — тоже.","
","^Ала долго смотрит на вас. Затем медленно кивает, словно молчание — тоже своего рода ответ. Так оно и есть.","
",{"->":".^.^.hub_intro"},null],"hub_intro":["^Она садится на подножку тягача. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_hauler","/#","
","^Спрашивай, если собираешься. Отвечу то, что сочту нужным. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.hub"},null],"hub":["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","^Она ждет. Хранитель на крыше поворачивается во сне на другой бок. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.menu"},null],"menu":[["ev","str","^Что в прицепе?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_trailer"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Куда мы едем?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_north"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Кто платит охотникам?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_hunters"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Хватит.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_trailer","re":true},"^Книги. Записи погибшего доктора из долины, за сорок лет. Ильзе Мартен, которая лечила всю долину. Моя мать прятала их три года. Потом комендант прочла имя на обложке, и теперь они запечатаны её сургучом. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она чеканит слова, словно заученный урок, и замолкает раньше, чем успевает сказать, что в них записано.","
","^В баре говорят, что это лекарство. Но это бумага. То, за что долина отдаст воду — сначала для Майи, а потом для Дворов. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_north","re":true},"^В <term=northgate>Северные Ворота</term>. Долина на краю дороги, с источником. Их Смотритель шлет по реле депеши в каждый форт на моем пути и предупреждает вежливо: поворачивай назад. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Назад я не поверну. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_hunters","re":true},"^Хедда Вэлл. Она правит в Блэквуде и сама назначила награду соляркой. Вернусь ли я живой, ей плевать. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она произносит это имя сухо и тяжело — так говорят о долге, который несешь годами.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Ясности прибавилось, но безопаснее дорога не стала.","
",{"->":"start.maya"},null]}],null],"maya":["#","^checkpoint: start.maya","/#","^Ала не встает. Она смотрит на цистерну, затем на свои руки. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^img: road_ala","/#","
","^На третью ночь у Майи снова подскочил жар. В записке от Сары сказано, что её бьет озноб, она каждый час зовет меня, а потом спрашивает, как выглядит долина. Я не знаю, что ей сказать. Сама её в глаза не видела. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она молчит и ни о чем не просит. Но по этому молчанию ясно: она ждет именно этих слов.","
",{"->":".^.^.promise"},null],"promise":[["ev","str","^Я довезу вас.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Промолчать.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"promised","re":true},"^Эти слова слетают сами собой. Обычно таких обещаний вы не даете. Никому в жизни такого говорить не доводилось, и вы слишком хорошо знаете, какую тяжесть на себя берете.","
","^Ала долго смотрит на вас. Коротко кивает и не благодарит: за такой долг простым «спасибо» не отделаешься.","
",{"->":"start.close"},null],"c-1":["
","^Вы молчите. Для такого человека самое безопасное — промолчать.","
","^Она кивает, словно ничего другого и не ждала, и от этого почему-то только хуже.","
",{"->":"start.close"},null]}],null],"close":["^Ала поднимается. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Тогда на рассвете. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Вы идете проверять ремни, все до одного. Ослабнет ремень, и двигатель закипит. На здешней площадке есть сварщик, работающий по ночам, и вы оставляете ему пару монет за шов на разведчике.","
","end",null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_trailer"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_north"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_hunters"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Dusk at the eighth fort, and the Keepers are counting the evening's trucks through the gate. ","#","^place: The eighth outpost ","/#","#","^img: road_gate","/#","
","^Three and four trucks at a time came out of the badlands today, and some of them were army trucks from the old depots. Both of yours are still rolling. The scout is held together now with the yard's weld and most of the pay.","
","^An old Keeper stands at the gate with a tally board, a man who has counted trucks for thirty years and looks it. He counts the hauler. He counts your scout. Then he stops counting and looks at the back of your neck, where your collar rides low. ","#","^page","/#","
","^I knew a man with a burn like that. ","#","^speaker: Bram","/#","
","^He says it mildly, the way you'd mention the weather. You know the ring he means. Every Burnt Driver who ever plugged into the wrong seat wore it, and the Keepers wrote down every one they saw. Then he turns to the next truck and goes on counting. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Your hand has gone to your neck without asking you. It has started to shake against the scar, and Ala is watching it. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.hand"},{"hand":[["ev","str","^Keep your hand still.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Let it shake.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",false,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hand_shook","re":true},{"->":"start.still"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hand_shook","re":true},{"->":"start.shaking"},null]}],null],"still":["^You press the hand flat against your thigh and hold it there until the shaking stops. It costs more than the stretch did.","
","^Ala watches you do it. She sees that it was a choice, and she doesn't say what she thinks of the choice.","
",{"->":".^.^.news"},null],"shaking":["^You leave it where it is. It shakes, and you let her see it shake.","
","^Ala watches it for a long moment. She doesn't look away, and she doesn't ask. That is a courtesy, of a kind.","
",{"->":".^.^.news"},null],"news":["#","^checkpoint: start.news","/#","^She sits down on the hauler's step with a strip of paper from the fort's relay, folded small. She does not count the pay into your hand. It is the first time she hasn't. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Hedda Vell has changed the reward. It pays for the crates burned now, not brought back. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She reads it flat, line by line, the way she reads a sum. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Her soldiers wouldn't fire on the Yards. They found it half empty, and the rest standing at the Yards' own gate with my mother in front, and they went home. Blackwell has shut its gates. The forts have opened the road north to the sick, toll-free. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^The second slip is in her mother's hand, a few lines, hard as a nail. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Don't come back. Keep going north. Maya asks for you every hour. ","#","^speaker: Sara","/#","
","^The third slip is Northgate's, in a clerk's neat hand. ","#","^page","/#","
","^A boy has died at the Keepers' gate for want of what we keep. Come. Your niece will drink our water. ","#","^speaker: Warden's relay","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.loss"},null],"loss":[["#","^checkpoint: start.loss","/#","^She folds the slips together and puts them in her coat. The Warden's slip spoke of a boy, and she holds a moment before she says the rest. His name was Teo. He was six, and he died on the verge outside the southern fort three days ago. His family had been turned back at the gate, and the forts changed their minds the day after. ","#","^page","/#","
","^She is waiting to see what you do with that.","
","ev","str","^Tell her you're sorry.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Ask what she needs.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Say nothing.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^sorry","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"grief_said","re":true},"^You say it. She takes it the way she takes an M, and checks it.","
","^Don't. Not yet. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":"start.why"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^ask","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"grief_said","re":true},"^Nothing you carry, she says. It is the first time she has refused you something kindly.","
",{"->":"start.why"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^silent","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"grief_said","re":true},"^You don't say you're sorry. It would not help her, and she'd hold it against you.","
",{"->":"start.why"},null]}],null],"why":["^Eight stretches, and you're still here with your hands on the wheel. Nobody does that for the pay. So why do you do this? ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.hub"},null],"hub":["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","^She waits. At the gate the tally goes on. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.menu"},null],"menu":[["ev","str","^Why do so many hunt the truck?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_hunters"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why don't you leave the truck and run?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_run"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^I thought this road would finish me.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^I promised.","/str",{"VAR?":"promised"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^The pay.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},"ev","str","^Say nothing.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_hunters","re":true},"^Because of what Blackwell paid, and because of what the bar says. On the hiring night a hunter sat at my table, and I said too much. By morning every driver on the road knew that I carry a cure. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^It isn't one. It's forty years of a doctor's notes, and they say that children from poisoned ground got well on the valley's water, season after season. The cure is the spring. The notes are the proof. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She doesn't smile. She's too tired to.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_run","re":true},"^Run where? Two hundred people are walking north behind this truck. They can't stop, because there's nothing behind them to stop for. Maya's among them, or soon will be. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^My father died on this road because he wouldn't leave his tanker. I'll be damned if I do less. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"father_told"},"!","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Jon, his name was. A linked driver, in the first water convoy Blackwell sent, and the <term=burnt_drivers>Burnt Drivers</term> took it at the pass sixteen years ago. I haven't told you that. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^You know the pass. You know which wall of it the sun leaves first. You keep your eyes on the tally board.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.20"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^finish","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"why_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.finish"},null],"c-3":["
","ev","str","^promised","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"why_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.promised_answer"},null],"c-4":["
","ev","str","^pay","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"why_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.for_pay"},null],"c-5":["
","ev","str","^silent","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"why_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.silent"},null]}],null],"finish":["^Out it comes, flat, and it's true. That was the plan: a road long enough, enough trucks, and sooner or later one of them would be the one. It never is.","
","^Ala looks at you for a time. Her face doesn't change.","
","^That's honest. It's also a terrible reason to hire a man. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She almost smiles, and doesn't.","
",{"->":".^.^.close"},null],"promised_answer":["^Two words, and you don't add a third.","
","^Ala's face does something you haven't seen it do. She looks at the hauler instead of at you, and she nods at the hauler.","
","^I know. I remember. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.close"},null],"for_pay":["^The pay, you tell her, as if the pay were a reason.","
","^Nobody stays for the pay. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^She says it without any heat. She's seen through it, and she lets you keep it.","
",{"->":".^.^.close"},null],"silent":["^You say nothing. The gate goes on counting.","
","^She nods slowly, as if she'd put a price on the silence. Maybe she has.","
",{"->":".^.^.close"},null],"close":["#","^checkpoint: start.close","/#","^Ala gets up and brushes off her coat. She walks to the hauler and stands with her hand on the door for a moment, longer than it takes to open. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Tomorrow. ","#","^speaker: Ala","/#","
","^You go and check the water cans, both of them. ","ev",{"VAR?":"hand_shook"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Your hand shakes on the first cap and is steady by the second. ",{"->":".^.^.^.18"},null]}],"nop","ev",{"VAR?":"hand_shook"},"!","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Your hand is steady, and you wonder how much it cost. ",{"->":".^.^.^.24"},null]}],"nop","^ ","#","^page","/#","
","end",null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_hunters"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_run"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"grief_said"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

ru.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Сумерки в восьмом форте. Хранители ведут вечерний учет машин у ворот. ","#","^place: Восьмой пост ","/#","#","^img: road_gate","/#","
","^Сегодня из пустошей вылетали по три, по четыре машины разом, и на некоторых была армейская краска со старых складов. Обе ваши машины всё ещё на ходу. Разведчик теперь держится на сварке да почти на всей плате за перегоны.","
","^У ворот с планшетом для записей стоит старый Хранитель: видно, что он считает грузовики уже лет тридцать. Отмечает тягач. Заносит в список вашего разведчика. Затем замирает и вглядывается вам в затылок, где сбился воротник. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Знал я одного с таким же ожогом. ","#","^speaker: Брам","/#","
","^Он роняет это буднично, будто о погоде обмолвился. Вы знаете, о каком кольце речь. Такой шрам носил каждый Обожженный, подключившийся к чужому креслу, а Хранители переписывали каждого, кого видели. Затем он поворачивается к следующей машине и продолжает счет. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Ваша рука сама собой тянется к шее. Пальцы на шраме начинает бить дрожь, и Ала не спускает с них глаз. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.hand"},{"hand":[["ev","str","^Унять дрожь в руке.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Дать руке дрожать.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",false,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hand_shook","re":true},{"->":"start.still"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hand_shook","re":true},{"->":"start.shaking"},null]}],null],"still":["^Вы прижимаете ладонь к бедру и держите её, пока дрожь не унимается. Сил на это уходит больше, чем на весь перегон.","
","^Ала смотрит на это. Она понимает, чего стоило это усилие, и держит мысли при себе.","
",{"->":".^.^.news"},null],"shaking":["^Вы оставляете руку на месте. Пальцы дрожат, и вы даете ей это видеть.","
","^Ала долго смотрит на дрожащие пальцы. Взгляда не отводит и ни о чем не спрашивает. В своем роде это тоже вежливость.","
",{"->":".^.^.news"},null],"news":["#","^checkpoint: start.news","/#","^Она садится на подножку тягача с мелко сложенным листком из радиопункта форта. Плату вам в руку она не отсчитывает. Такое происходит впервые. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Хедда Вэлл изменила награду. Теперь платят за сожженные ящики, а не за доставленные. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она читает это сухо, строчка за строчкой, словно сверяет счет. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Её солдаты не стали стрелять по Дворам. Они нашли Дворы наполовину пустыми, а остальные стояли у ворот самих Дворов во главе с моей матерью, и солдаты ушли домой. Блэквуд запер ворота. Форты открыли дорогу на север для больных, без пошлины. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Второй листок написан рукой матери — несколько строк, жестких, как приговор. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Не возвращайся. Иди на север. Майя зовет тебя каждый час. ","#","^speaker: Сара","/#","
","^Третий листок — из Северных Ворот, аккуратным почерком писаря. ","#","^page","/#","
","^У ворот Хранителей умер мальчик — ему не хватило того, что храним мы. Приезжай. Твоя племянница будет пить нашу воду. ","#","^speaker: Реле Северных Ворот","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.loss"},null],"loss":[["#","^checkpoint: start.loss","/#","^Она складывает листки вместе и убирает в пальто. В листке Смотрителя говорилось о мальчике, и она медлит секунду перед тем, как сказать остальное. Его звали Тео. Ему было шесть лет, и он умер на обочине возле южного форта три дня назад. Его семью развернули у ворот, а форты передумали лишь день спустя. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Она ждет, что вы на это скажете.","
","ev","str","^Сказать, что вам жаль.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Спросить, что ей нужно.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Промолчать.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^sorry","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"grief_said","re":true},"^Вы говорите это. Она принимает эти слова, как принимает монету, и проверяет на фальшь.","
","^Не надо. Пока не надо. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":"start.why"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^ask","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"grief_said","re":true},"^— Ничем из того, что у тебя есть, тут не помочь, — говорит она. Впервые она отказывает по-доброму.","
",{"->":"start.why"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^silent","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"grief_said","re":true},"^Вы не говорите, что вам жаль. Ей это не поможет, а на вас она затаит обиду.","
",{"->":"start.why"},null]}],null],"why":["^Восемь перегонов, и ты всё ещё держишься за руль. Ради платы так никто не делает. Зачем тебе всё это? ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.hub"},null],"hub":["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","^Она ждет. У ворот продолжается учет. ","#","^page","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.menu"},null],"menu":[["ev","str","^Почему за грузовиком столько охотников?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_hunters"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Почему не бросить грузовик и не сбежать?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_run"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Думалось, эта дорога станет для меня последней.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Слово дано.","/str",{"VAR?":"promised"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Из-за платы.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},"ev","str","^Промолчать.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_hunters","re":true},"^Из-за платы Блэквуда и из-за барных баек. В ночь найма ко мне за стол подсела охотница, и с языка сорвалось лишнее. К утру каждый водитель на дороге знал, что я везу лекарство. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Никакое это не лекарство. Это сорок лет записей доктора, и там написано, что дети с отравленной земли выздоравливали от воды из долины, сезон за сезоном. Лекарство — это источник. А записи — доказательство. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она не улыбается. Сил на улыбку не осталось.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_run","re":true},"^Куда бежать? Две сотни людей идут на север следом за этим грузовиком. Остановиться они не могут: позади ничего не осталось. Майя среди них — или скоро будет. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Мой отец погиб на этой дороге, потому что не пожелал бросить свою цистерну. Будь я проклята, если сделаю меньше. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"father_told"},"!","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Джон, так его звали. Водитель в сцепке, в первом водовозном конвое Блэквуда, и <term=burnt_drivers>Обожженные</term> перебили их на перевале шестнадцать лет назад. Я тебе об этом ещё не говорила. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Вам знаком этот перевал. Известно, какую стену солнце покидает первой. Вы не сводите глаз с планшета для записей.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.20"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^finish","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"why_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.finish"},null],"c-3":["
","ev","str","^promised","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"why_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.promised_answer"},null],"c-4":["
","ev","str","^pay","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"why_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.for_pay"},null],"c-5":["
","ev","str","^silent","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"why_answer","re":true},{"->":"start.silent"},null]}],null],"finish":["^Слова звучат сухо, и это правда. В этом и был расчет: дорога подлиннее, машин побольше, и рано или поздно какая-нибудь из них станет той самой. Но всё никак не становится.","
","^Ала долго не отводит от вас взгляда. Лицо её не меняется.","
","^Честный ответ. Хотя для нанимателя хуже причины и не придумаешь. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она почти улыбается, но сдерживается.","
",{"->":".^.^.close"},null],"promised_answer":["^Всего пара слов, и третьего добавлять незачем.","
","^Лицо Алы меняется так, как вам ещё не доводилось видеть. Она смотрит на тягач вместо вас и кивает ему.","
","^Я знаю. Я помню. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.close"},null],"for_pay":["^Вы ссылаетесь на плату — будто плата может быть причиной.","
","^Ради платы никто не остается. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Она говорит это без злости. Она видит вас насквозь и оставляет эту отговорку при вас.","
",{"->":".^.^.close"},null],"silent":["^Вы молчите. У ворот продолжается счет.","
","^Она медленно кивает, словно назначила молчанию цену. Может, так оно и есть.","
",{"->":".^.^.close"},null],"close":["#","^checkpoint: start.close","/#","^Ала встает и отряхивает пальто. Она идет к тягачу и на миг замирает, положив руку на дверь, — дольше, чем нужно, чтобы её открыть. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Завтра. ","#","^speaker: Ала","/#","
","^Вы идете проверять обе канистры с водой. ","ev",{"VAR?":"hand_shook"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ На первой крышке рука дрожит, но ко второй дрожь унимается. ",{"->":".^.^.^.18"},null]}],"nop","ev",{"VAR?":"hand_shook"},"!","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Рука не дрожит, и остается лишь гадать, чего это стоило. ",{"->":".^.^.^.24"},null]}],"nop","^ ","#","^page","/#","
","end",null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_hunters"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_run"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"grief_said"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Hollis Brennan. I run the stills at the <term=pump_station>Pump Station</term>. Drums are stacked by the gate if you're buying. If you've got tools or batteries, I'm buying.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What does the Pump Station make?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who buys the drums?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_buyers"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Diesel, in drums. The pumpjack lifts crude off an Old World well, and the stills cook it down.","
","^The pump shakes itself loose all day, and every fix costs a wrench or a file. Its motor runs on batteries from <term=nose>Nose</term>. With weak batteries or nothing to mend it, it limps along at half speed. Half speed is half the drums.","
","ev",{"x()":"works_down"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^The pump's down right now. Every drum by the gate is what's left until it turns again.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.9"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^tools","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^I'm out of tools. One more cracked wrench and the pump runs slow.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.18"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^batteries","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^The batteries are flat, the last of them. The motor coughs more than it turns.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.27"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_buyers","re":true},"^The convoys load here and run them out to Nose and <term=bowl>Bowl</term>, and every outpost that sells fuel buys some.","
","^Nose burns my diesel in its forge and in the shop where it makes batteries. The tools and batteries I need come out of those fires, so the same convoys bring them back. That's the whole trade.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Mind the drums on the way out. They're full.","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_buyers"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Холлис Бреннан. Я слежу за кубами на <term=pump_station>Насосной станции</term>. Если покупаешь, бочки сложены у ворот. Если у тебя есть станки или аккумуляторы, я покупаю.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Что производит Насосная станция?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Кто покупает бочки?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_buyers"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Пока.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Солярку в бочках. Качалка поднимает сырую нефть из скважины старого мира, а кубы её варят.","
","^Насос весь день разбалтывается от тряски, и на каждый ремонт уходит ключ или напильник. Мотор работает на аккумуляторах с <term=nose>Носа</term>. Со слабыми аккумуляторами или когда чинить нечем, он еле тянет вполсилы. А вполсилы — это вдвое меньше бочек.","
","ev",{"x()":"works_down"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Насос сейчас стоит. Все бочки у ворот — это всё, что осталось, пока он снова не повернется.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.9"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^tools","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^У меня кончились станки. Ещё один треснувший ключ, и насос станет крутиться медленно.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.18"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^batteries","/str",{"x()":"short_of","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Аккумуляторы сели, до последнего. Мотор больше чихает, чем крутится.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.27"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_buyers","re":true},"^Колонны грузятся здесь и везут их на Нос и в <term=bowl>Чашу</term>, да и на каждом посту, где продают топливо, берут понемногу.","
","^Нос сжигает мою солярку в кузне и в цехе, где делает аккумуляторы. Нужные мне станки и аккумуляторы выходят из этого огня, так что те же колонны везут их обратно. Вот и вся торговля.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Смотри не задень бочки на выезде. Они полные.","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_buyers"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

en.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","#","^stat: money M's","/#","#","^fact: halves_fit Bench: Duvall's half of the brake rod and yours meet face to face, with no gap.","/#","#","^fact: report_seen Dispatch log: Corporal Teller's report says raiders ran wagon Seven down at the bend and the cannon went over the edge. Command wrote the wagon off.","/#","#","^fact: heard_duvall Duvall: the brake rod went on the bend, and the wagon couldn't slow. She hit the verge and went over. Nobody shot at them, and they walked.","/#","#","^fact: offer_heard Yard: Corporal Teller offered M's to drop the half rod down the sump. His stripes pay his sister's ration card.","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":[["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Lena looks at your truck through the shed door before she looks at you. Then at your hand, closed round something. ","#","^place: Nose, the Army bench","/#","
","^A young soldier sits on a crate by the bench with his left arm in a sling, sorting bolts into a tin with his right.","
","ev","str","^Put the half rod on the bench and say where it came from.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Put it back in your pocket and leave.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_rod"},"str","^held","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"halves_fit","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^.9"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":"bench"},null],"c-1":["
","^You leave her to her bolts. Behind you the soldier goes back to sorting, one-handed.","
","end",null]}],null],"bench":["#","^checkpoint: bench","/#","^You set the half rod down and tell her: the dead Army wagon in the hollow below the bend in the Bowl north road, the cannon still on her bed, and this, out of her brake linkage.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_rod"},"str","^held","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Lena holds the half rod up to the light, and her face goes still.","
","^Bright, flat, no rust, no saw marks. Nobody cut that. It broke in one go, with the brakes pulling on it. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^Ilan. Come and look at this. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^The soldier comes over. He takes half a brake rod from his shirt pocket and sets it face-down on yours. The broken faces meet with no gap between them.","
","^Private Ilan Duvall. He was the relief driver on wagon Seven. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^The rod went on the bend, and she wouldn't slow. We hit the verge, and that's how my arm went. I picked my half out of the wreck. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
",{"->":"bench.14"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Lena looks it over once and puts it down.","
","^Somebody beat the face off this. I can't read a break that isn't there. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^The soldier comes over and takes half a brake rod from his shirt pocket. He holds it beside yours. Its face is bright. Yours is a grey smear, and they don't meet.","
","^Private Ilan Duvall. He was the relief driver on wagon Seven. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":"bench.14"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.report"},{"report":["#","^checkpoint: bench.report","/#","^Command bought cheap brake rods for the depot trucks, and I fitted them by order. I wrote to command that they would kill somebody, and they filed it. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^Sergeant Kovac at dispatch logs every Army truck out and in. Here's his page for wagon Seven. I keep a copy, because my name's on her brakes. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^She pulls a creased sheet from under a tin of bolts and flattens it with her rag.","
","^Seven ; out ; cannon on swivel, depot brake rods ","#","^head","/#","
","^Report ; Cpl Teller ; raiders at the bend, cannon lost over the edge ","#","^row","/#","
","^Margin ; Pvt Duvall ; brake rod snapped ","#","^row","/#","
","^Command ; by order ; wagon written off ","#","^row","/#","
","^Raiders, it says. Raiders strip a cannon, and hers is still bolted to her bed. And raiders don't snap a brake rod. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^It's the first thing you've heard her say slowly.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"halves_fit"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Ilan's half on its own is a bit of steel in a private's pocket. It could be off any truck. Yours came out of the linkage on wagon Seven. Together they say this is the brake rod from wagon Seven, and your half stayed on her with the cannon. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.46"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"halves_fit"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Give it to Kovac. Fixing the report is command's business, and command may never look. But a rod that snapped on the road is enough for Kovac to keep every truck with those rods in the yard. That much is his to do. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.53"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^With a clean face, I'd send you straight to Kovac. This one, he'd log as scrap, unless somebody saw the face before it was beaten. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.53"},null]}],"nop","
","^You roll the half rod under your thumb on the bench. An hour with a punch in a hot hollow, and it comes down to who gets to hold it.","
","^The yard door opens. A corporal comes in with sun-dark forearms and stripes on his sleeve. He looks at the soldier's half, then at yours, then at his watch.","
","^Corporal Teller. A word outside, driver. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.hub"},null],"hub":[["ev","str","^Send for Kovac and give him the half rod.","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_rod"},"str","^held","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Tell Lena what the face looked like before you ruined it.","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_rod"},"str","^bent","/str","==",{"VAR?":"wagon_read"},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask Teller in front of Lena what happened on the bend. ","#","^check: social 2","/#","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_rod"},"str","^held","/str","==",{"VAR?":"wagon_read"},"||",{"VAR?":"offer_heard"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Take Teller back in and make him say it to Lena. ","#","^check: social 2","/#","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_rod"},"str","^held","/str","==",{"VAR?":"wagon_read"},"||",{"VAR?":"offer_heard"},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Step outside with Teller.","/str",{"VAR?":"offer_heard"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask Duvall what happened on the bend.","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_duvall"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Take Teller's M's.","/str",{"VAR?":"offer_heard"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Pocket the half rod and leave.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"report_seen","re":true},{"->":"bench.sign"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"report_seen","re":true},"^You tell her: bright, one clean slant, no saw marks and no rust. She listens with her rag still in her hands.","
","^That's a rod that snapped on the road. Tell Kovac that, the way you told me. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":"bench.sign"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"report_seen","re":true},{"->":"bench.admit"},null],"c-3":["
",{"->":"bench.admit"},null],"c-4":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"offer_heard","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"report_seen","re":true},"^The yard is hot and smells of the wash pit. Teller stands where the shed wall hides him from the bench. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Look. I wrote that raiders ran her down and the cannon went over the edge. A wagon down a slope isn't worth a tow, so command wrote her off, and nobody drove out to look at her brakes. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^Command's order says a depot rod holds if you take the bends slow. So if a rod goes on a bend, the driver took it fast. I was driving. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^In Nose a corporal's family eats on his card. My sister draws her bread on my stripes. Lose them, and her card goes back to the clerk, and she's got a boy of her own. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^Ilan says the rod broke. Lena says the rod broke. Kovac can't pull trucks off the road on a private's word or a mechanic's letter. A broken part off her brakes, he has to log as a fault. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^I'll pay you for it. It goes down the sump, and you never saw the hollow. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^He names a sum: ","ev",{"VAR?":"price"},"out","/ev","^ M. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","^He checks his watch while he waits. It's a good sum. You think about the sister, and then about the soldier's arm, and you can't make them weigh the same.","
","^He stays out in the yard to wait for your answer. You go back in to the bench.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_duvall","re":true},"^The soldier looks at the yard door before he answers.","
","^We came down onto the bend a bit fast. The corporal stood on the brakes, and the pedal went to the floor. She hit the verge and went over, and the door came in on my arm. The corporal pulled me out. Nobody shot at us. There wasn't anybody to shoot. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
","^We climbed out of the hollow and walked. He wrote raiders at the desk. I told Kovac it was the brake rod, and he put me in the margin. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
",{"->":"bench.sold"},null],"c-7":["
","^Teller watches you go all the way to your truck. Lena doesn't look up.","
","end",null]}],null],"sign":["ev","str","^logged","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"ev",{"VAR?":"fee"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Lena sends Duvall across the yard. He comes back with Sergeant Kovac, who has the log under his arm and reads the page standing up. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You put the half rod in his palm and tell him where it came from.","
","^Off wagon Seven's brakes, with the cannon still on her. I log it. Army steel brought in pays a finder's rate. ","#","^speaker: Kovac","/#","
","^He counts ","ev",{"VAR?":"fee"},"out","/ev","^ M onto the bench, then writes the half rod in under Teller's report in the same ink. He doesn't strike the report out.","
","^The report is command's. Whether they read past the first line isn't mine to decide. ","#","^speaker: Kovac","/#","
","^Then he opens the depot list and draws a line through two trucks that run on the same cheap rods. They stay off the road until Lena has looked at them.","
","^Teller goes out to the yard without a word. Duvall picks up his half of the rod and puts it back in his shirt pocket.","
","^If you drive down to Bowl, my mother buys her water at Hattie's well house. Tell her my arm's set. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
","end",null],"admit":["ev",{"VAR?":"offer_heard"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You call Teller in from the yard. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You put it to him in front of Lena, with the half rod between you on the bench: out in the yard he told you he wrote raiders so nobody would drive out and look at her brakes.","
","^I said nothing in the yard. It was dusty, and they were shooting. It was raiders. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.5"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Teller is still waiting by the door for his word outside. You give it to him here instead. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You put it to him in front of Lena, with the half rod between you on the bench: his report says raiders, and you took this off her brakes with the cannon still bolted to her bed.","
","^Then they left the cannon. It was dusty, and they were shooting. It was raiders. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.5"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"x()":"passed"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You don't argue.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_saw"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Then you ask him what the raiders shot with. You walked that hollow and found no casing in the grit and no bullet hole in the wagon.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.7"},null]}],"nop","
","^You don't look at Teller. You look at Duvall, and so does Teller. The boy rubs the strap of his sling. When he speaks, he uses Teller's first name.","
","^Bram. You pulled me out of that cab. You stood on that pedal, and nothing happened. Say it. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
","^Teller takes his hand off his watch. It's the soldier who breaks him, not you, and you're glad of it.","
","^The brake rod went on the bend, and she went over. I took the bend fast. I said raiders to keep my stripes. They pay my sister's ration card. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^Lena sends Duvall for Sergeant Kovac. Teller says it again in front of him and signs it. Kovac writes it under the raid report and crosses nothing out.","
","^Corporal. Water cart, from tomorrow. Leave the stripes on my desk. ","#","^speaker: Kovac","/#","
","^And my sister's bread? ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^A water carter's card feeds one man. Rations aren't mine to give. ","#","^speaker: Kovac","/#","
","^Kovac holds out his hand for the half rod. It's what you carried it up here for, and you give it to him. He counts out the finder's rate for it, ","ev",{"VAR?":"fee"},"out","/ev","^ M. Then he draws a line through two depot trucks with the same rods, off the road until Lena has looked at them.","
","ev","str","^admitted","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"ev",{"VAR?":"fee"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^If you drive down to Bowl, my mother buys her water at Hattie's well house. Tell her my arm's set. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.12"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You lean on it and tell him he lied in his report, that raiders don't leave a cannon behind. It comes out too fast and too loud, an accusation instead of a question. He hears that, and he steadies.","
","^I said it at the desk and I say it now. And this one was down in the hollow picking over Army property. Ask what else is in that truck. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^Lena sends Duvall for Sergeant Kovac. Kovac comes and logs the half rod as found, with your name as the finder and Teller's word beside it, and leaves the report standing above both.","
","^You'd have had a finder's rate for that. The Corporal says you stripped her, and that's one word against another. I don't pay out on those. ","#","^speaker: Kovac","/#","
","ev","str","^logged","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"^He still draws a line through two depot trucks with the same rods. Teller goes out. Lena wipes her hands on her rag and looks at neither you nor Teller. You can't tell which of you she's angrier with.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.12"},null]}],"nop","
","end",null],"sold":["ev",{"VAR?":"price"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev","str","^buried","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"^You go back out to the yard. Teller counts M's into your hand one at a time, and holds out his other hand for the half rod. ","#","^page","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_rod"},"str","^bent","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^He doesn't look at its face. He doesn't know what he's looking for.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.25"},null]}],"nop","
","^He walks it to the wash pit and drops it through the grate. You hear it hit water.","
","^When you go back past the shed, Lena is writing on a scrap of sign-out sheet and doesn't look up. Duvall is turning his half of the rod over in his fingers. Kovac's page still says raiders, and the trucks with the same rods still go out in the morning.","
","end",null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_rod"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ala_hired"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_1"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_4"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_8"},false,{"VAR=":"road_seen_12"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"geezer_pitch"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ring_told"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"death_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"why_answer"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ala_knows"},false,{"VAR=":"father_told"},false,{"VAR=":"promised"},false,{"VAR=":"hand_shook"},false,{"VAR=":"scale_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_met"},false,{"VAR=":"halves_fit"},false,{"VAR=":"report_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"offer_heard"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_duvall"},60,{"VAR=":"price"},20,{"VAR=":"fee"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

facts.name: halves_fit
facts.text: Bench: Duvall's half of the brake rod and yours meet face to face, with no gap.

facts.name: report_seen
facts.text: Dispatch log: Corporal Teller's report says raiders ran wagon Seven down at the bend and the cannon went over the edge. Command wrote the wagon off.

facts.name: heard_duvall
facts.text: Duvall: the brake rod went on the bend, and the wagon couldn't slow. She hit the verge and went over. Nobody shot at them, and they walked.

facts.name: offer_heard
facts.text: Yard: Corporal Teller offered M's to drop the half rod down the sump. His stripes pay his sister's ration card.

ru.story:
